explanations.allowedFileExtensions: which files can covalent examine. files not in this list will be ignored
explanations.allowedFolders: folders that will be examined. Empty will include all folders
explanations.repo: where the charts are saved. `git` for git repo, `local` for local folder, `remote` for remote Covalent server
explanations.gitRemoteUrl: used when repo is set to `git`. i.e https://github.com/codechart/staging-diagrams.git
explanations.remote_archiveUrl: used when repo is set to `remote`. i.e `https://staging.cochart.dev/` or `https://<ip_address>:2900/`
